query: insert into agents (organization_id, id, name, enabled, is_default, cost_tier, created_at) values ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, to_timestamp($7::bigint / 1000.0)) on conflict (organization_id, id) do update set name = excluded.name, enabled = excluded.enabled, is_default = excluded.is_default, cost_tier = excluded.cost_tier
